result:
A common setup is to email Nate when a lead replies and wants a call, since he owns the outreach pipeline and can decide how to respond. Brandon shouldn't be bothered with every reply, so he doesn't get that one.

The lead-signed email is the one that should go to Brandon, and not to Nate, because Brandon handles the contract and the handoff to delivery. Nate can see all of it in the database if he wants. In short: replies go to Nate, signed goes to Brandon, and each gets only their own event to keep the inboxes quiet.
